propositions: External integration tests currently run against only one live provider (Anthropic) despite rebar supporting Anthropic, Bedrock, and OpenAI, leaving provider-specific regressions undetected by CI
Provider selection must be a matrix dimension in CI workflows rather than an ambient default, with each arm explicitly configuring its provider through REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE overlay

Bedrock arm credentials must be obtained via OIDC role assumption on GitHub-hosted runners, not EC2 instance roles, with explicit region configuration via both AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION
Missing credentials for a matrix arm must result in a loud skip distinguishable from a passing run, never a silent green or indistinguishable behavior
Config overlays must set only [llm.model_classes] and leave other discovered config intact, ensuring provider and model are fully qualified rather than falling back to ambient defaults
Live test execution counts from canary markers must be verified to exclude the false-negative case where a job conclusion reports green despite all tests being skipped
